master_prompt: Start over completely. Create an ORIGINAL premium illustrated mascot LOGO for TODDY OS, a real independent Linux operating system. The dog MUST unmistakably be an ADULT SHIH-TZU, not a generic dog, not a monkey, and not an abstract symbol. Show a head-and-neck portrait in a subtle three-quarter view: very SHORT FLAT MUZZLE, rounded broad head, long silky drooping ears, cream/white moustache and beard with a few expertly designed tufts, warm chestnut-brown ear and eye patches, small black nose. It wears tasteful slightly oversized rounded-square BLACK EYEGLASSES. Actual intelligent expressive eyes are visible through clear lenses, with one subtly raised brow and a very slight head tilt that conveys dry wit: an experienced software architect who has just fixed your computer. Funny through personality, not babyish or goofy. No tongue, no wink, no exaggerated grin, no human body, tie or costume. Design it as a PROFESSIONAL ILLUSTRATOR'S DISTRO MASCOT: confident bold dark outlines of consistent weight, carefully balanced simplified vector-style shapes, 4 restrained flat colors (deep charcoal, warm ivory, chestnut and tiny muted copper accent), elegant negative spaces and highly controlled detail. More sophisticated editorial caricature / classic open-source project identity than cute mobile app sticker. It MUST retain believable Shih-tzu anatomy and its furry short-muzzled face. A beautifully typeset exact wordmark 'Toddy OS' underneath in mature distinctive sans-serif typography, clean spacing. Centered compact composition on a clean solid warm ivory background, ample margins. NO abstract glasses-only icon, NO blank face, NO inverted-U ears-only mark, NO esports shield, NO clipart, NO 3D, NO photorealism, NO gradients or shadows, NO neon or robot/circuit decorations, NO wallpaper or presentation collage, NO watermark. Deliver one carefully crafted identity, with the recognizable funny bespectacled Shih-tzu as the hero.

Genuine alpha-transparent background around the head; the dog's ivory fur must remain opaque. No wordmark, no tile, no badge, no extra objects, no gradient or shadow, no watermark.
